scheme_name: Scheme for assistance for Start Ups/ Innovation: Interest Subsidy
other_conditions: Any individual or group of individuals with an innovative idea or concept, recommended by an approved Nodal Institution, is eligible.
Startups in any sector or branch of science, technology, engineering, agriculture, healthcare, etc., are eligible (sector‑agnostic).
Startups availing benefits under the Student Startup and Innovation Policy (SSIP) are also eligible.
benefits_summary: Interest subsidy of 1% up to a maximum of 9% on term loans for MSME assistance.
